description: This file provides functions for image comparison, including pixel color difference analysis, variance, and structural similarity (SSIM). It is used to calculate and visualize differences between two images, supporting visual testing or diffing tasks in a testing framework.

methods.name: function drawPixel(width: number, data: Buffer, x: number, y: number, r: number, g: number, b: n/ drawPixel
methods.description: Draws a pixel at (x, y) position with specified RGB color, updating the provided data buffer.

methods.name: export function compare(actual: Buffer, expected: Buffer, diff: Buffer|null, width: number, heig/ compare
methods.description: Compares two image buffers (actual and expected), optionally outputs differences to a diff buffer, and returns the count of differing pixels based on color difference and structural metrics.
